features.text: TARGETED FOOT AND ANKLE SUPPORT: Short walker stabilizes injuries while allowing easier mobility.
CUSTOM FIT CONTROL: Adjustable straps and malleable uprights adapt to swelling and dressings.
AIRMESH LINER COMFORT: Ventilated liner manages heat and moisture for long wear.
ROCKER SOLE MOTION: Dual axis bottom encourages a more natural walking pattern.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L4387, L4386: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
